core_claim: The Super Bowl ad of the 2010s is markedly less funny, less sexual, and more patriotic than the Super Bowl ad of the 2000s — and the canonical 'post-9/11 patriotic boom' never showed up in the data; the patriotic surge is a 2017 phenomenon.
